title: Cyphersummon
summary: Cyphersummon is a summoning spell used by the Casterwill family that allows the caster to manifest their Cypherdex. This spell is identical to Cyphercall and similar to Bladecall.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Teien Casterwill used this spell in Huntik International HQ to call her Cypherdex, revealing to the other council members that she was a secret Casterwill family member. [S2E37]

Sophie Casterwill used the spell on the longest night of the year to call her Cypherdex and transmit the location of the Spiral Mark to the Huntik Foundation Scramjets. [S2E49] During the final battle with the Betrayer, Sophie used it again so that she could find the real prophecies of Nostradamus. [S2E52]

Cyphersummon is a summoning spell used by the Casterwill family that allows the caster to manifest their Cypherdex. This spell is identical to Cyphercall and similar to Bladecall.

History

Sophie Casterwill used the spell on the longest night of the year to call her Cypherdex and transmit the location of the Spiral Mark to the Huntik Foundation Scramjets. [S2E49] During the final battle with the Betrayer, Sophie used it again so that she could find the real prophecies of Nostradamus. [S2E52]
